manual.doors_and_trapdoors.line2: {0}Treated Wood Doors and Trapdoors are nothing special, only a fancier version of the standard wooden door.{1}
manual.doors_and_trapdoors.line3: They are made with treated wood planks and come in steel-framed and wooden variants.
manual.doors_and_trapdoors.line4: {0}Steel Doors and Trapdoors are a more secure variant of iron doors, suitable for uses in high-security facilities.{1}
manual.doors_and_trapdoors.line5: Unlike iron doors, they respond to normal opening procedures instead of only opening when a redstone signal is applied.{0}
manual.doors_and_trapdoors.line6: When a redstone signal is applied, a locking mechanism activates and the door cannot be opened until the signal is disabled.
